caption:
Hybi's Weekly Recap for Mar 4–13 is here.

Front of your shins aching when you walk faster? Seated toe raises, 15 reps twice a day, lowering over 3 seconds, can help. Hanging out the washing is often easier on your back with the basket on a chair at waist height and you facing the line. Working across two monitors? Keep the main screen straight ahead and change position once an hour. Baristas can try a gentle forearm stretch, 20 seconds × 2 each side, every break.

Scroll back through this week's posts for the full comics. Book online via the link in bio 🐰
